line: La última hoja llevaba tres días pidiendo agua.
note: hook: the dry leaf and the empty can, no actor, no exposition of the room

line: El jardinero abrió el grifo; solo salió aire.
note: setup: the tap fails; the gardener's reach is the first action, not a pose

line: El aprendiz trajo la regadera vacía.
note: escalation: the empty can is the obstacle made visible; no long explanation

line: Al fondo, el barril de lluvia seguía lleno.
note: development: the decision is spatial; the barrel is revealed and the apprentice turns toward it

line: El aprendiz cruzó el invernadero con la regadera llena.
note: action: the carried can moves 140 px, under the teleport guard; the reach is the pour
reaction: wordless close-up; the plant's change is the cause

line: La planta bebió; la flor abrió.
note: close: the plant blooms; the object changed state, not only the narration
